decision_hierarchy.description: Existing independently recorded human decisions remain authoritative and immutable.
Exactly one SEC candidate EIN equals the Form 5500 sponsor EIN encoded by sponsor_id.
All candidate SEC EINs are available and none equals the Form 5500 sponsor EIN.
Exactly one candidate's SEC API legal registrant name equals the normalized Form 5500 sponsor legal name, and no known candidate SEC EIN contradicts the sponsor EIN for that exact-name candidate.
Any case not satisfying a deterministic rule remains unresolved for targeted adjudication.

reason_for_amendment: The fuzzy review population contains 2,153 sponsors. Five sponsors were independently manually adjudicated, including both score-100 candidates. The remaining population is processed using deterministic secondary identifiers to avoid falsely representing automated decisions as human review.
